title: Racer: Hunting GPU Kernel Bugs with Symbolic Equivalence Checking
abstract: arXiv:2610.28429v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: GPU kernels are critical to the performance of today's AI services, yet the same operators are rewritten repeatedly: for each GPU generation, numeric format, serving regime, and kernel language. Every rewrite must preserve the function computed by the implementation it replaces. Today, this obligation depends almost entirely on differential testing: run the new kernel and a trusted reference on randomly sampled tensors, then compare their outputs within a tolerance. This approach has blind spots that additional test cases cannot eliminate. For example, a logical bug may produce an error smaller than the tolerance required to accommodate a correct optimized kernel.   We propose symbolic equivalence checking, which executes a kernel and its reference on symbolic inputs, turning each output cell into an exact algebraic expression, and then checks whether the paired expressions agree for all inputs. translated_title: Racer：利用符号等价性检查猎捕GPU内核缺陷
translated_abstract: GPU内核对当今AI服务的性能至关重要，然而相同的算子却被反复重写：针对每一代GPU、数值格式、服务场景和内核语言都需要重新实现。每一次重写都必须保持与被替代实现所计算的函数一致。目前，这一验证任务几乎完全依赖于差分测试：在随机采样的张量上运行新内核和可信的参考实现，然后在容差范围内比较它们的输出。这种方法存在无法通过增加测试用例来消除的盲点。例如，一个逻辑缺陷可能产生的误差小于为容纳正确的优化内核所需的容差。我们提出符号等价性检查方法，它在符号输入上执行内核及其参考实现，将每个输出单元转换为精确的代数表达式，然后检查这些配对表达式是否对所有输入都一致。由于这些表达式是精确的，符号等价性检查……
tldr: 提出符号等价性检查方法Racer，通过在符号输入上执行GPU内核与参考实现，将输出转化为精确代数表达式并验证对所有输入的一致性，从而发现传统差分测试无法检测的GPU内核逻辑缺陷。
en_tdlr: Racer introduces symbolic equivalence checking, which executes GPU kernels and their references on symbolic inputs and verifies that the resulting exact algebraic output expressions agree for all inputs, catching kernel bugs that differential testing cannot detect.
